verdict.rationale: Pricing and rate limits are a fair question for a hosted MCP connection platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents per-call or per-connection pricing, plan tiers, or rate limits. The hosted connection services were shut down on 2026-10-31 and the docs tree has been removed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent pricing per tool call or connection plus documented rate limits before committing to the platform
